# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** 18 years old  <sub>[v2 c29 P24](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Treasurer of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society  <sub>[v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Di  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with rosy cheeks, black eyes, and glossy jet-black hair. Her merry expression is inherited from her father. As she grows older, she tends to gain weight and worries about her plump stature.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c17 P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010), [v2 c17 P4](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0004), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c29 P30](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0030)_

## Personality

Diana is good, smart, and ladylike, with a comfortable, stanchly loyal, and cheerful demeanor. She laughs easily and is quite practical, though her mother once scolded her for imagining ghosts into the Haunted Wood. She reads frequently and enjoys sharing stories and gossip with her friends.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009), [v1 c19 P81](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0081), [v1 c21 P17](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0017), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v2 c6 P2](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0002)_

## History

Diana grows up at Orchard Slope and meets Anne Shirley when Anne comes to Green Gables. The two swear eternal bosom friendship by a brook, spending their childhood playing in spots like Idlewild and Willowmere, creating a story club, and attending Avonlea school together. After accidentally getting drunk on Marilla's currant wine, Diana is briefly forbidden by her strict mother from playing with Anne, but they are reconciled after Anne helps cure her little sister Minnie May of severe croup. She sings a solo at the Avonlea hall concert and later visits Charlottetown with Anne and her father. Though her parents decide against sending her to Queen's Academy, she maintains her deep bond with Anne. Later, Diana becomes treasurer of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society, joins in group outings to places like Echo Lodge, and eventually becomes engaged to Fred Wright.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c25 P50](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0050), [v1 c26 P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v1 c29 P15](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0015), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c21 P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 c29 P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)_
